scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix senatus ci && npm --prefix executioner ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix lib/queue ci
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run dev:infra && npm run runtimes:pull && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run dev:infra && npm run build:queue && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "QUEUE,SENATUS,EXECUTIONER,WEB" "npm run dev:queue" "npm run dev:senatus" "npm run dev:executioner" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:infra:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.q.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.q.yml up -d
scripts.build: npm run build:queue && npm run build:senatus && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:senatus && npm run typecheck:executioner && npm run typecheck:queue
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.quality:strict: npm run lint:strict && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run quality && npm run build
